title: ID0467526-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/T94002909175] Charging Station Blocked
description:
Reported behavior/Issue: Charging Station Blocked
Translation of the issue:
With our Siemens Sicharge D (OCPP 1.6), users can stop the DC charging process at any time via the app using RemoteStopTransaction, even though the vehicle is still plugged in.
The transaction is terminated, the charging station remains physically blocked, and blocking fees no longer apply. This behavior is being deliberately abused.
Question/suggested solution:
Is there a firmware or configuration option to deactivate RemoteStop or to ensure that the charging process is completed when the plug is removed?
Solution:
How to Implement an "Idle/Blocking Fee" Policy:
How it works: When your CSMS receives a RemoteStopTransaction request from a user's app, it sends the RemoteStopTransaction to the SiD. The SiD will then send a StopTransaction confirmation.
The crucial next step
: Your CSMS should then immediately check the SiD's outlet status. If the outlet StatusNotification still indicates that the charging point is Occupied (meaning the cable is still connected) but the ChargingState is no longer Charging (because the transaction stopped), your CSMS can initiate a new "idle" or "blocking" fee timer for that specific connector.
User Notification: The app should clearly inform the user that while the charging session has ended, a blocking fee will apply until the vehicle is unplugged.
Here you can do the logic of sum of kWh + idle timer.
